title: Codex x DSH Team Toolkit ownership manifest (installed ledger)
description: Written by install/Invoke-Toolkit.ps1 into <target>/.codex-dsh-team-toolkit/manifest.json. It records safe relative paths and state metadata only: no checksum, hash or digest field exists anywhere in this document. Ownership is proved at run time by comparing a managed file byte for byte with its pristine baseline under <state>/pristine/<same relative path>; a file may be replaced or deleted only while it is byte-identical to that baseline. The ledger is self-locating (it describes the state directory layout, never an absolute project path), so a relocated project keeps working. It never contains file contents, credentials, secret values or absolute personal paths.

location.description: Self-locating state layout. No absolute path and no location digest is ever persisted.

pristineRoot.description: Directory (inside the state directory) that holds the exact installed bytes of every managed file

dependencyArchive.description: Optional compressed original contents for dependency paths. Entries use the project-relative path; comparisons read actual uncompressed bytes, never a digest. Other baselines retain the normal per-file layout.

directories.description: Directories created by this installation, relative to the project. Existing project directories are preserved. Null or absent denotes a legacy ledger.

path.description: Managed path, relative to the target project root.

pristine.description: Baseline path relative to the state directory: pristine/<the same relative path>. This is the only ownership reference; it is a path, never a digest.
